series.name: CSDC/CSDH board series — PK tech video tables (SDH/CSDC/CSDH)
series.notes: PK HVAC technician video series (Expert AC Error Codes + Forever Tech + Babar + Blue Corner + Fully4world + TAHIR etc.) for CSDC/CSDH board labels on SDH models. Outdoor LED blink counts recorded in blinkPattern. Medium confidence (video+captions, no OEM PDF).

title.ur: E0 bahar ka / hifazati fault (CSDC)

meaning.en: Outdoor LED blinks 7 times in a cycle. Video walkthrough checks compressor overload, discharge-pipe sensor, and outdoor fan motor. Fully4world describes E0 as PCB/IPM/IGBT short — series-dependent.
meaning.ur: Outdoor LED ek cycle mein 7 baar blink karta hai. Video walkthrough mein compressor overload, discharge pipe sensor aur outdoor fan motor check kiye gaye hain. Fully4world ke mutabiq E0 PCB/IPM/IGBT short hai — series par depend karta hai.

causes.ur: Compressor overload khula ho ya jami hua ho
Bahar ke discharge pipe sensor ka open/short
Bahar ka fan motor nahi chal raha

causes.en: Outdoor PCB / IPM short (alternate board mapping)
causes.ur: Bahar ka PCB / IPM short (doosre board ka mapping)

solutions.en: Count outdoor LED blinks carefully (expect 7) and confirm series
solutions.ur: Outdoor LED ke blinks ghin kar gin lein (7 hone chahiye) aur series ki tasdeeq karein

solutions.en: Measure overload continuity; bypass-test only if procedure is known safe
solutions.ur: Overload ki continuity napayen; sirf usi surat mein bypass test karein jab tareeqa maloom aur mehfoz ho

solutions.en: Replace discharge pipe sensor; check outdoor fan and PCB if code remains
solutions.ur: Discharge pipe sensor badal dein; agar code wahi rahe to outdoor fan aur PCB check karein

source.title: Changhong ruba AC E0 Error Code — Expert AC Error Codes

notes.en: Conflicts with Fully4world E0=PCB/IPM short (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b_y5dUPGZ3w). Record board silkscreen (CSDC vs other) before acting.
notes.ur: Yeh Fully4world ke E0=PCB/IPM short wale kehne se conflict karta hai (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b_y5dUPGZ3w). Koi bhi kaam se pehle board ka silkscreen note karein (CSDC ya doosra).

title.ur: E1 — indoor display circuit ki kharabi

meaning.en: Indoor display section / display harness to indoor PCB is faulty.
meaning.ur: Indoor display section, yaani display harness se indoor PCB tak ka raasta, kharab hai.

causes.en: Loose or broken indoor display connector wires
causes.ur: Indoor display connector ke taare dhile ya toote huay
Indoor display module kharab

causes.en: Indoor PCB section that drives the display is bad
causes.ur: Display ko chalane wala indoor PCB ka hissa kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off, reseat display harness, check continuity
solutions.ur: Bijli band karein, display harness dobara lagayein, continuity check karein

solutions.en: Replace indoor display module
solutions.ur: Indoor display module badal dein

solutions.en: If display swaps good but code stays, repair/replace indoor PCB display driver section
solutions.ur: Display badalne ke baad bhi code rahe to indoor PCB ka display driver hissa marammat karein ya badal dein

source.title: Changhong Ruba AC E1 Error Codes DC Inverter Series

notes.en: Separate CSDH-titled E1 video (DICE7fGZtnU) audio leans indoor motor — treat E1 meaning as board-dependent.
notes.ur: CSDH title wali alag E1 video (DICE7fGZtnU) ki awaz indoor motor ki taraf jhukti hai — E1 ka matlab board par depend karta hai.

title.ur: E2 bahar ke fan motor ka fault

meaning.en: Outdoor fan motor is not running or feedback failed.
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan motor nahi chal raha ya feedback nakaam raha.

causes.en: Outdoor fan motor jammed or winding open
causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor jami hua ho ya winding khuli ho

causes.en: Outdoor fan connector loose on PCB
causes.ur: PCB par outdoor fan connector dhila ho

causes.en: Outdoor PCB fan drive section failed
causes.ur: Bahar ke PCB ka fan drive hissa fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Check outdoor fan spins freely with power isolated
solutions.ur: Power isolate karke dekh lein ke outdoor fan azaad ghoomta hai ya nahi

solutions.en: Replace outdoor fan motor or repair connector/PCB drive
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan motor badal dein ya connector/PCB drive marammat karein

source.title: Changhong Ruba AC E2 Error codes DC Inverter Series

title.ur: E3 (CSDC/CSDH) hifazati code — compressor ka rasta (kamzor shahadat)

meaning.en: Dedicated E3 video exists but auto-captions are mostly channel intro; nearby E4 content discusses compressor phase/startup. Meaning not firmly extracted.
meaning.ur: E3 ki alag video mojood hai lekin auto captions zyada tar channel intro hain; qareeb ki E4 video mein compressor phase/startup ki baat hui hai. Matlab poori tarah nahi nikal aaya.

causes.en: Likely compressor startup / phase issue (inferred from sibling E4 material)
causes.ur: Mumkin hai compressor startup ya phase ka masla ho (E4 ki video se andaaza lagaya gaya)

causes.en: Possible protection latch pending full video review
causes.ur: Protection latch ho sakta hai — poori video dekh kar tasdeq hogi

solutions.en: Watch full E3 video without relying on auto-captions
solutions.ur: E3 ki poori video dekhein, auto captions par bharosa na karein

solutions.en: Verify outdoor LED blink count against service notes if available
solutions.ur: Agar service notes maujood hon to outdoor LED ke blink count se mila kar dekh lein

source.title: Chanhongruba AC E3 Error code — Expert AC Error Codes

notes.en: Do not publish E3 meaning as fact until human review of video audio.
notes.ur: Video ki awaz ka insani review hone tak E3 ke matlab ko fact ke tor par publish na karein.

title.en: E4 compressor start / phase / IPM fault
title.ur: E4 compressor ka start / phase / IPM fault

meaning.en: Outdoor LED blinks 4 times; compressor fails to phase-lock or start; check IPM/module and compressor terminals.
meaning.ur: Bahar wala LED 4 baar blink karta hai; compressor phase-lock ya start nahi karta; IPM/module aur compressor terminals check karein.

causes.en: Inverter compressor open/short or not starting
causes.ur: Inverter compressor khula/shart ho ya start hi nahi ho raha
Bahar wale PCB ka IPM/IGBT module kharab

causes.en: Burnt compressor harness or bad continuity to PCB
causes.ur: Compressor harness jal chuka ho ya PCB tak ki continuity kharab ho

solutions.en: Count outdoor LED (expect 4) to confirm E4
solutions.ur: E4 ki tasdeq ke liye outdoor LED gin lein (4 hone chahiye)

solutions.en: Check compressor terminal continuity and PCB wiring
solutions.ur: Compressor terminals ki continuity aur PCB ki wiring check karein

solutions.en: Repair/replace outdoor PCB IPM section or compressor after isolation tests
solutions.ur: Isolation test ke baad outdoor PCB ka IPM hissa ya compressor marammat karein ya badal dein

source.title: Changhong ruba AC E4 Error code — Expert AC Error Codes

notes.en: Sibling upload F9yq0PS4VE8 titled E3 repeats the same E4/4-blink script — possible title mix-up on channel.
notes.ur: Bhai upload F9yq0PS4VE8 jis ka title E3 hai wahi E4/4-blink wala script dobara deta hai — channel par title mix-up ho sakta hai.

title.ur: E5 — gas/charge se mutaliq fault

meaning.en: Technician videos treat E5 as gas/pressure or related outdoor issue (check gas first).
meaning.ur: Technician videos E5 ko gas/pressure ya us se mila jula outdoor masla shamil karte hain (pehle gas check karein).

causes.en: Low or abnormal refrigerant charge / leak
causes.ur: Refrigerant charge kam ya ghalat, ya phir leak

causes.en: Outdoor sensor or pressure path fault presenting as E5 on some boards
causes.ur: Kuch boards par outdoor sensor ya pressure path ka masla E5 ki shakal mein aata hai

causes.en: Compressor not pumping (also seen with E8)
causes.ur: Compressor pump nahi kar raha (E8 ke saath bhi dekha gaya hai)

solutions.en: Check gas pressure/leak per RAC procedure before replacing parts
solutions.ur: Parts badalne se pehle RAC ke tareeqe se gas pressure aur leak check karein

solutions.en: Verify outdoor sensors and then PCB if gas is correct
solutions.ur: Gas theek ho to outdoor sensors verify karein, phir PCB dekhein

source.title: E5 ERROR CHANGHONG RUBA AC error code e5 problem solutions

notes.en: Also covered by Babar Electronics HVACR titles (DDyXysqZ1Hg, 2f8AwhutQVY) — captions not harvested.
notes.ur: Yeh Babar Electronics HVACR titles (DDyXysqZ1Hg, 2f8AwhutQVY) mein bhi cover hua hai — captions collect nahi kiye gaye.

title.en: E8 outdoor PCB memory OR weak compressor pumping
title.ur: E8 — outdoor PCB memory ya kamzor compressor pumping

meaning.en: Two PK technician readings: (1) outdoor PCB memory/system fault (Expert CSDC); (2) compressor pumping worn / low gas circulation (S4 Shamsi, GENERAL ELECTRONICS).
meaning.ur: Do Pakistani technicians ki do readings: (1) outdoor PCB memory/system fault (Expert CSDC); (2) compressor ki pumping ghati hui hai ya gas ka circulation kam hai (S4 Shamsi, GENERAL ELECTRONICS).

causes.ur: Bahar ke PCB ka EEPROM/memory kharab hona
Compressor ki pumping capacity khatam ho gayi
Gas ka circulation kam ya charge adhoora

solutions.en: Inspect outdoor PCB memory section / reprogram or replace board
solutions.ur: Outdoor PCB ka memory section dekhein, phir dobara program karein ya board badal dein

solutions.en: Check gas charge and compressor amp draw; repair compressor circuit if charge OK
solutions.ur: Gas charge aur compressor ka amp draw check karein; charge theek ho to compressor circuit marammat karein

source.title: Chanhong Ruba AC E8 error code CSDC AND CSDH Series

notes.en: Second opinion: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lRW4s_DA8Hc and https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5au2uoLSeh4
notes.ur: Doosri raye ke mutabiq: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lRW4s_DA8Hc aur https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5au2uoLSeh4

title.ur: EE andar ke PCB ka memory/EEPROM fault

meaning.en: Indoor shows EE; outdoor LED blinks 25 times; indoor PCB memory/EEPROM section failed.
meaning.ur: Indoor par EE aata hai; outdoor LED 25 baar blink karta hai; indoor PCB ka memory/EEPROM hissa kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.ur: Andar ke PCB ka EEPROM/data kharab hona

causes.en: Indoor PCB hardware failure in memory circuit
causes.ur: Andar ke PCB ka memory circuit wala hardware fail

solutions.en: Count outdoor LED (25) and confirm EE on indoor
solutions.ur: Outdoor LED (25) gin lein aur indoor par EE ki tasdeeq karein

solutions.en: Service/reprogram indoor PCB or replace indoor board
solutions.ur: Indoor PCB service karwayein ya dobara program karein, warna naya board lagayein

source.title: Changhong Ruba AC EE Error Code CSDC CSDH Series

title.en: F0 indoor fan motor no feedback; outdoor fan on some PCBs
title.ur: F0 andar ke fan motor ka feedback nahi; kuch PCBs par bahar ka fan

meaning.en: Most sources: indoor fan motor jammed/open/loose or no feedback to PCB. M Arslan: two Ruba PCB types — same F0 is outdoor fan on one model, indoor fan on the other.
meaning.ur: Zyada tar zara: indoor fan motor jami hua, khula ya dhila ho, ya PCB ko feedback hi nahi mil raha. M Arslan ke mutabiq Ruba ke do PCB qisme hain — wohi F0 aik model par outdoor fan hai aur doosre par indoor fan.

causes.en: Indoor blower jammed (debris, rat damage to wires)
causes.ur: Indoor blower jam hua (gand, chuhe ne taare nuksaan de diye)

causes.en: Fan motor winding or connector open
causes.ur: Fan motor ki winding ya connector khuli ho

causes.en: Outdoor fan motor fault on alternate F0 mapping
causes.ur: Doosri F0 mapping par outdoor fan motor ka masla

causes.en: Indoor PCB motor driver / capacitor path
causes.ur: Andar ke PCB ka motor driver / capacitor wala rasta

solutions.en: With power isolated, free the blower and inspect motor
solutions.ur: Power isolate karke blower ko azaad karein aur motor check karein

solutions.en: Check motor connector and capacitor; replace motor if open
solutions.ur: Motor connector aur capacitor check karein; motor khula ho to badal dein

solutions.en: If indoor motor OK, identify PCB type — F0 may be outdoor fan
solutions.ur: Agar indoor motor theek hai to PCB ka qism maloom karein — F0 outdoor fan ka bhi ho sakta hai

source.title: Changhong Ruba AC F0 Error Code CSDC CSDH Series

notes.en: Dual mapping: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QarSES6LQDM ; also Forever Tech https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=opz2QMn-vto
notes.ur: Do matlab milte hain: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QarSES6LQDM ; aur Forever Tech https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=opz2QMn-vto

title.en: F1 indoor room temperature sensor fault
title.ur: F1 andar ke kamre ka temperature sensor fault

meaning.en: Indoor room/air temperature sensor open, short, or contaminated; outdoor LED blinks 29 times.
meaning.ur: Andar ke kamre/hawa ka temperature sensor open, short ya ganda ho; bahar wala LED 29 baar blink karta hai.

causes.en: Room temp sensor open or shorted
causes.ur: Room temperature sensor khula ya shart ho
Sensor bulb par paani, mitti ya insulation

causes.en: Broken sensor harness to indoor PCB
causes.ur: Andar ke PCB tak ka sensor harness toota hua

solutions.en: Count outdoor LED (29) and inspect sensor bulb
solutions.ur: Bahar wale LED (29) ginein aur sensor bulb ko dekhein

solutions.en: Clean/dry sensor; replace if reading wrong
solutions.ur: Sensor saaf aur sookha karein; reading ghalat ho to badal dein

solutions.en: If new sensor does not clear F1, check indoor PCB sensor input
solutions.ur: Naye sensor se bhi F1 na hate to indoor PCB ka sensor input check karein

source.title: Changhong Ruba DC inverter Error Code (F1 Indoor Room Temperature Sensor Fault)

notes.en: Also hvacdirectplus F1–F3 article; Expert video esMWce2wScY.
notes.ur: Is ke ilawa hvacdirectplus ka F1–F3 article aur Expert ki video esMWce2wScY bhi hai.

title.ur: F2 bahar ka temperature sensor fault

meaning.en: Outdoor ambient (yellow) temperature sensor open/short; outdoor LED blinks 12 times. Some blogs label F2 as outdoor discharge sensor — conflict.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ambient (peela) temperature sensor khula/shart; outdoor LED 12 baar blink karta hai. Kuch blogs F2 ko outdoor discharge sensor kehte hain — masla hai.

causes.en: Outdoor ambient sensor open/short or burnt
causes.ur: Outdoor ambient sensor khula/shart ya jal chuka ho

causes.en: Water ingress or air vacuum in sensor pocket
causes.ur: Sensor ke pocket mein paani ka dakhil ya hawa ki khami
Bahar ke PCB par sensor input ka fault

solutions.en: Confirm blink count 12 and sensor color/location
solutions.ur: Blink count 12 aur sensor ka rang/jagah tasdeeq karein

solutions.en: Replace outdoor ambient sensor; clear wiring
solutions.ur: Bahar wala ambient sensor badal dein, wiring saaf karein

solutions.en: If code remains, inspect outdoor PCB sensor circuit
solutions.ur: Agar code wahi rahe to outdoor PCB ka sensor circuit dekhein

source.title: Changhong Ruba AC F2 error code CSDC AND CSDH Series

notes.en: Conflict: mashallah blog calls F2 outdoor *discharge* sensor.
notes.ur: Conflict: mashallah blog F2 ko bahar ka *discharge* sensor kehta hai.

title.en: F3 indoor coil (pipe) temperature sensor fault
title.ur: F3 andar ke coil (pipe) ka temperature sensor fault

meaning.en: Indoor copper/pipe coil sensor open/short or dirty; outdoor LED blinks 28 times.
meaning.ur: Andar ke tanbe/payp ke coil sensor ka open/short ya ganda hona; bahar wala LED 28 baar blink karta hai.

causes.ur: Indoor coil ka sensor khula ya shart

causes.en: Mud/carbon in sensor tube or sensor not seated
causes.ur: Sensor ki tube mein mitti/karbon jama hui hai ya sensor sahi jagah baitha nahi
Andar ke PCB par sensor input fail hona

solutions.en: Remove sensor, clean tube, refit, verify continuity
solutions.ur: Sensor nikalein, tube saaf karein, dobara lagayein aur continuity verify karein

solutions.en: Replace indoor pipe sensor
solutions.ur: Indoor pipe sensor badal dein

solutions.en: If still F3, repair indoor PCB sensor circuit
solutions.ur: Phir bhi F3 ho to indoor PCB ka sensor circuit marammat karein

source.title: Changhong Ruba AC F3 Error Codes CSCD CSDH

notes.en: Agrees mashallah F3 + hvacdirectplus F1–F3.
notes.ur: Mashallah F3 aur hvacdirectplus F1–F3 se agree karta hai.

title.en: F4 outdoor condenser pipe sensor or indoor fan (conflict)
title.ur: F4 bahar ka condenser pipe sensor ya andar ka fan — sources alag batate hain

meaning.en: CSDC/CSDH video: outdoor condenser pipe / discharge path sensor. Mashallah table lists F4 twice: indoor fan motor AND outdoor section line sensor. Forever Tech also has F4 video.
meaning.ur: CSDC/CSDH video: bahar ke condenser pipe / discharge path ka sensor. Mashallah table mein F4 do bar hai: andar ka fan motor AUR bahar ke section ki line sensor. Forever Tech ka bhi F4 video hai.

causes.ur: Bahar ke condenser pipe sensor ka open/short

causes.en: Indoor fan motor fault (alternate mapping on mashallah list)
causes.ur: Andar ke fan motor ka fault (mashallah list par doosra mapping)

causes.en: Sensor not in contact with condenser tube
causes.ur: Sensor condenser tube se rabta nahi kar raha

solutions.en: Identify which F4 table matches the board silkscreen
solutions.ur: Peechane ke mutabiq dekhein ke board ka silkscreen kaun si F4 list se match karta hai

solutions.en: Check outdoor condenser/discharge sensors and wiring
solutions.ur: Bahar ke condenser/discharge sensors aur wiring check karein

solutions.en: If fan mapping, service indoor fan motor path
solutions.ur: Agar fan mapping ki baat ho to indoor fan motor ka raasta service karein

source.title: Changhong Ruba AC F4 error code CSDC AND CSDH Series

notes.en: Conflict hub: mashallah duplicate F4; hvacdirectplus F4 article; Forever Tech EB9J0RQrMRI.
notes.ur: Conflict ka markaz: mashallah mein F4 dobara; hvacdirectplus ka F4 article; Forever Tech EB9J0RQrMRI.

title.en: F5 outdoor discharge sensor or gas pressure (conflict)
title.ur: F5 bahar ka discharge sensor ya gas pressure — sources alag batate hain

meaning.en: Expert CSDC: outdoor LED 8 blinks, discharge pipe sensor / compressor heat-up path. Mashallah: gas pressure high or low.
meaning.ur: Expert CSDC: outdoor LED 8 baar blink karta hai, discharge pipe sensor ya compressor ke garm hone ka raasta. Mashallah: gas pressure zyada ya kam.

causes.en: Outdoor discharge pipe sensor open/short or wrong position
causes.ur: Bahar ke discharge pipe sensor ka open/short ya ghalat jagah
Compressor garam ho jana / bahar ki airflow ruki ho
Refrigerant pressure zyada ya kam
Bahar wala fan garami bahar nahi nikal raha

solutions.en: Count outdoor LED (8) and refit/replace discharge sensor
solutions.ur: Bahar wale LED (8) ginein aur discharge sensor dobara lagayein ya badlein

solutions.en: Verify gas pressure and outdoor fan speed
solutions.ur: Gas pressure aur bahar wale ki speed verify karein

solutions.en: Clear condenser airflow; repair outdoor PCB if sensors OK
solutions.ur: Condenser ka hawa ka raasta saaf karein; sensors theek hon to outdoor PCB marammat karein

source.title: Changhong Ruba AC F5 error code CSDC AND CSDH Series

notes.en: Conflict: mashallah F5=Gas Pressure High or Low; hvacdirectplus F5=discharge sensor.
notes.ur: Conflict: mashallah ke mutabiq F5=Gas Pressure High or Low, lekin hvacdirectplus F5=discharge sensor kehta hai.

title.ur: F6 andar aur bahar ka serial communication error

meaning.en: When indoor and outdoor ends lose serial communication. Outdoor PCB damage/fuse, burnt components, or indoor→outdoor supply switching failure can cause it.
meaning.ur: Jab indoor aur outdoor ke darmiyan serial rabta toot jata hai. Outdoor PCB ki damage ya fuse, jalay huay components, ya indoor se outdoor power switching ka masla is ki wajaah ban sakta hai.

causes.en: Outdoor PCB fuse blown or board damaged
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ka fuse jal gaya ya board kharab ho chuka
Indoor se outdoor power/switching relay kharab
Dono units ke darmiyan communication harness toota hua

causes.en: Mismatched indoor/outdoor boards after parts swap
causes.ur: Parts badalne ke baad indoor aur outdoor boards aik doosre se mismatch ho gaye

solutions.en: Power down; inspect comm wires for continuity and correct pairing
solutions.ur: Power band karein; communication taaron ki continuity aur sahi jor check karein

solutions.en: Check outdoor PCB fuse and power path from indoor
solutions.ur: Outdoor PCB ka fuse aur indoor se aane wala power ka raasta check karein

solutions.en: If boards mismatched, restore original pair or reflash/replace
solutions.ur: Agar boards mismatch hain to asal jor wapas lagayein ya dobara flash karein/ badal dein

source.title: Changhong Ruba Dc Inverter AC F6 Error Code Complete Detail Explanation

notes.en: Also mashallah F6; Expert GUq8mGgY9_8; Babar aUDrHvfOsgE (multi-brand board).
notes.ur: Iske alawa mashallah F6, Expert GUq8mGgY9_8 aur Babar aUDrHvfOsgE (multi-brand board) ka video bhi hai.

title.ur: F7 kamre ka temperature (RT) sensor fault

meaning.en: Blue Corner: board marks RT = room temperature; RT sensor fault shows F7.
meaning.ur: Blue Corner: board par RT ka matlab hai room temperature; RT sensor kharab ho to F7 aata hai.

causes.ur: Room temperature sensor khula ya shart
RT harness nuksaan de chuka hai

solutions.en: Replace RT sensor and clear error
solutions.ur: RT sensor badal kar error khatam karein

solutions.en: Verify sensor reading against known-good unit
solutions.ur: Sensor ki reading ko hal chalan wali unit se mila kar dekh lein

source.title: F6,F7,F8 error codes in Changhong ruba Ac

notes.en: Babar also titles multi-brand F7 outdoor-PCB videos — platform code may differ.
notes.ur: Babar multi-brand F7 outdoor-PCB videos ka bhi title deta hai — platform ka code alag ho sakta hai.

title.ur: F8 pipe/point temperature (PT) sensor ka fault

meaning.en: PT (point/pipe temperature) sensor fault shows F8 per Blue Corner.
meaning.ur: Blue Corner ke mutabiq PT (point/pipe temperature) sensor kharab hone par F8 aata hai.

causes.ur: Pipe/point temperature sensor khula ya shart
Sensor pipe se juri/bond nahi hua

solutions.en: Replace PT sensor; refit in factory position
solutions.ur: PT sensor badal dein aur factory ki jagah par dobara laga dein

solutions.en: Check harness continuity to indoor PCB
solutions.ur: Andar ke PCB tak harness ki continuity check karein

source.title: F6,F7,F8 error codes in Changhong ruba Ac

notes.en: AAMIR RAC title also lists F8.
notes.ur: AAMIR RAC ki list mein F8 bhi likha hai.

meaning.en: Dedicated CSDC/CSDH P0 video; auto-captions are channel boilerplate plus compressor/IPM discussion. Not finalized.
meaning.ur: CSDC/CSDH ki alag P0 video; auto captions mein channel ka khana ba-qaida sa content aur compressor/IPM ki guftagu hai. Mamla pakka nahi hua.

causes.en: Suspected module/protection family (same script family as P1) — unconfirmed
causes.ur: Shak hai ye module/protection ki family hai (P1 jaisi hi script family) — tasdeq nahi hui
Insaan ko khud sunna zaroori hai

solutions.en: Listen to full P0 video audio without captions
solutions.ur: P0 video ki poori audio bina captions ke sun lein

solutions.en: Log outdoor LED count if any
solutions.ur: Agar koi ho to bahar wale LED ki ginti record karein

source.title: Changhong Ruba AC P0 Error CODE CSDC CSDH Series

notes.en: Audio leans inverter compressor / terminal checks — may overlap E4.
notes.ur: Awaz inverter compressor / terminal checks ki taraf jhukti hai — E4 se overlap ho sakta hai.

title.en: P1 (CSDC/CSDH) — display shows P1; extract pending
title.ur: P1 (CSDC/CSDH) — display par P1 aata hai; matlab nikalna baqi hai

meaning.en: Video states indoor display shows P1; remainder of transcript still intro-heavy.
meaning.ur: Video ke mutabiq indoor display par P1 aata hai; baaqi transcript abhi bhi zyada tar intro hai.

causes.en: Unconfirmed protection code — human review required
causes.ur: Is hifazati code ki abhi tak tasdiq nahi hui — insani review zaroori hai
Shayad ye P0 ke saath compressor/module ki family hai

solutions.en: Full audio review of P1 upload
solutions.ur: P1 upload ki poori audio ka jaiza lein

solutions.en: Do not guess parts replacement from P1 alone
solutions.ur: Sirf P1 ke baas par parts badalne ka khayal na karein

notes.en: Confidence is low: single video source and the transcript is mostly intro, so the P1 meaning is unverified — verify on your model before acting.
notes.ur: Confidence kam hai: sirf ek hi video source hai aur uska transcript zyadatar intro par hai, is liye P1 ka matlab tasdiq shuda nahi — kaam se pehle apne model par verify karein.

title.en: P2 input voltage high or low
title.ur: P2 — input voltage zyada ya kam

meaning.en: Input voltage above ~250 V or below ~160 V trips P2; outdoor LED blinks 13 times.
meaning.ur: Input voltage ~250 V se zyada ya ~160 V se kam hone par P2 aata hai; outdoor LED 13 baar blink karta hai.

causes.ur: Mains par over voltage 250 V se zyada
Mains par under voltage 160 V se kam
Supply be qeem ya stabilization kharab

solutions.en: Measure input with meter; correct supply before reset
solutions.ur: Meter se input napayen; reset se pehle supply theek karein

solutions.en: Install suitable stabilizer; retest
solutions.ur: Munasib stabilizer lagayein; phir se test karein

solutions.en: Count outdoor LED (13) to confirm P2
solutions.ur: P2 ki tasdeeq ke liye outdoor LED (13) gin lein

source.title: Changhong ruba AC P2 Error code

notes.en: Outdoor LED 13 from ASR "terah darfa" (Hindi/Urdu for "13 times").
notes.ur: Outdoor LED 13, ASR se mila — 'terah dafa'.

title.en: P3 — indoor/outdoor sensor + gas leak path
title.ur: P3 — andar/bahar ke sensors + gas leak ka rasta

meaning.en: Video path: check indoor/outdoor sensors, then gas leakage; outdoor PCB may also be implicated.
meaning.ur: Video ke raste mein: pehle andar/bahar ke sensors check karein, phir gas leakage; bahar ka PCB bhi shaq mein ho sakta hai.

causes.en: Indoor or outdoor temperature sensor faulty
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor temperature sensor kharab
Refrigerant leak ya gas kam

causes.en: Outdoor PCB fault after sensors OK
causes.ur: Sensors theek hone ke baad outdoor PCB ka masla

solutions.en: Replace/check both indoor and outdoor sensors
solutions.ur: Indoor aur outdoor dono sensors check karein ya badal dein

solutions.en: Leak-test and correct charge
solutions.ur: Leak test karein aur charge theek karein

solutions.en: Then service outdoor PCB
solutions.ur: Phir bahar wale PCB ki service karein

source.title: Changhong Ruba AC — P3 (CSDC/CSDH sensor/gas path)

notes.en: Title not re-verified this session; content clearly P3 + gas/sensors.
notes.ur: Is session mein title dobara verify nahi hua; content clearly P3 + gas/sensors hai.

title.ur: P4 — indoor sensor ki temperature zyada

meaning.en: Indoor copper + air sensors involved; changing both indoor sensors often clears P4; else indoor PCB.
meaning.ur: Indoor copper aur air sensors ka masla hai; indoor ke dono sensors badalne se aksar P4 theek ho jata hai; warna indoor PCB.

causes.en: Indoor coil or room sensor reading out of range
causes.ur: Indoor coil ya room sensor ki reading hadd se bahar hai
Andar ke PCB ka sensor input fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Replace both indoor sensors and retest
solutions.ur: Indoor ke dono sensors badal kar phir se test karein

solutions.en: If P4 remains and room not hot, replace/repair indoor PCB
solutions.ur: Agar P4 rahe aur kamra garm na ho to indoor PCB badal dein ya marammat karein

source.title: Changhong Ruba AC P4 Error CODE CSDC CSDH Series

title.ur: P5 — airflow/gas/sensor ki protection

meaning.en: Outdoor LED blinks 19 times; checks: indoor air filter block, gas pressure, indoor copper sensor and outdoor sensor seating.
meaning.ur: Outdoor LED 19 baar blink karta hai; jaan lein: indoor air filter band, gas pressure, indoor copper sensor aur outdoor sensor ki sahi positioning.

causes.en: Blocked indoor air filter / poor airflow
causes.ur: Indoor air filter band ya airflow kamzor
Gas pressure ghalat hai

causes.en: Indoor or outdoor sensors not seated / faulty
causes.ur: Andar ya bahar ke sensors sahi se nahi baithe / kharab hain

solutions.en: Clean filters; confirm blink count 19
solutions.ur: Filters saaf karein; blink count 19 ki tasdeeq karein

solutions.en: Check gas pressure in standby/run
solutions.ur: Standby/run ke dauran gas pressure check karein

solutions.en: Refit or replace indoor/outdoor sensors; then outdoor PCB
solutions.ur: Andar/bahar ke sensors dobara lagayein ya badlein; phir bahar wale PCB ki service karein

source.title: Changhong Ruba AC P5 Error CODE CSDC CSDH Series

title.ur: P6 heating-mode / overload ki hifazat

meaning.en: Occurs mainly in heating mode; outdoor LED blinks 20 times; sensor, compressor overload, discharge sensor, ventilation checks.
meaning.ur: Zyadatar heating mode mein hota hai; bahar wala LED 20 baar blink karta hai; sensor, compressor overload, discharge sensor, ventilation checks.

causes.ur: Heating cycle mein sensor kharab
Compressor overload trip hua ya kharab
Discharge sensor / bahar ki kamzor ventilation
Bahar ke PCB ka galat trip

solutions.en: Count outdoor LED (20); inspect heating sensors
solutions.ur: Bahar wale LED (20) ginein; heating sensors ko dekhein

solutions.en: Test/replace overload; check discharge sensor placement
solutions.ur: Overload test karein ya badlein; discharge sensor ki jagah check karein

solutions.en: Clear outdoor airflow; verify gas; then PCB
solutions.ur: Bahar ki airflow saaf karein; gas verify karein; phir PCB dekhein

source.title: Changhong Ruba AC P6 Error CODE CSDC CSDH Series

title.ur: P7 over-voltage (PCB kharab)

meaning.en: When indoor or outdoor PCB is damaged it starts reporting P7 over-voltage.
meaning.ur: Jab indoor ya outdoor PCB kharab ho jata hai to ye P7 over voltage ki shikayat karta hai.

causes.ur: Over voltage ke baad PCB nuksaan de chuka ho

causes.en: Sensing section of PCB reports false/true over-voltage
causes.ur: PCB ka sensing hissa ghalat ya asal over voltage ki baat karta hai

solutions.en: Measure mains; if normal, inspect indoor/outdoor PCB for damage
solutions.ur: Mains napayen; agar normal ho to indoor aur outdoor PCB ki damage dekhein

solutions.en: Repair/replace damaged PCB; improve surge protection
solutions.ur: Kharab PCB ki marammat ya tabdeeli karein; surge protection behtar karein

source.title: Changhong Ruba AC P7Error CODE CSDC CSDH Series

notes.en: EN auto-captions state PCB damage → P7 over voltage.
notes.ur: EN auto-captions mein PCB damage likha hai → P7 over voltage.

title.en: P8 high or low output voltage
title.ur: P8 — output voltage zyada ya kam

meaning.en: Outdoor LED blinks 16 times; high or low voltage output detected — open indoor and outdoor PCBs for inspection.
meaning.ur: Outdoor LED 16 baar blink karta hai; output voltage zyada ya kam detect hua — indoor aur outdoor dono PCB khol kar dekh lein.

causes.ur: Over-voltage wale output stage ka fault
Under-voltage output / supply section ka fault

solutions.en: Confirm blink count 16
solutions.ur: Blink count 16 ki tasdeeq karein

solutions.en: Isolate power; inspect indoor and outdoor PCB voltage rails
solutions.ur: Bijli alag karein; andar aur bahar ke PCB ke voltage rails dekhein

solutions.en: Repair or replace faulty PCB section
solutions.ur: PCB ka kharab hissa marammat karein ya badal dein

source.title: Changhong Ruba AC P8 Error CODE CSDC CSDH Series

title.en: P9 outdoor PCB IPM module fault
title.ur: P9 bahar ke PCB ka IPM module fault

meaning.en: Outdoor PCB IPM/IGBT module bad — compressor may not run; check module, heat-sink paste, and wiring to compressor.
meaning.ur: Bahar ke PCB ka IPM/IGBT module kharab hai — compressor shayad na chale; module, heat-sink paste aur compressor tak ki wiring check karein.

causes.ur: IPM/IGBT module kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Burnt compressor wiring causing module failure
causes.ur: Jal chuki compressor wiring module ko kharab kar rahi hai

causes.en: Poor heatsink paste / module not seated on sink
causes.ur: Heatsink ki paste kamzor ya module sink par baitha hi nahi

solutions.en: Inspect module and compressor terminal wiring
solutions.ur: Module aur compressor terminals ki wiring dekhein

solutions.en: Re-paste/reseat module; replace module or outdoor PCB
solutions.ur: Module ki dobara paste lagayein aur sahi baithayein; module ya outdoor PCB badal dein

solutions.en: Test compressor windings before final PCB install
solutions.ur: Last PCB lagane se pehle compressor ki winding test karein

source.title: Changhong Ruba AC P9 Error CODE CSDC CSDH Series
